files.name: PillarOut.java

help: Stuck in water after shore timed out: jump and place blocks under your feet to stand up out of the water
lesson: Shore keeps timing out in the same underground water after interrupting collect; two swim-toward-land fixes lost, so this one doesn't move sideways at all and stacks blocks under itself to get out of the water where it is.
summary: pillar_out: after shore TIMEOUT/STUCK while in water, jumps and places blocks under its own feet (mining a ceiling block if needed) to stand up out of shallow/underground water instead of retrying routes
